correctness.rationale: Exact idempotent recurrence x_next=a*x^2 on each disjoint permutation cycle has only zero or d=\(\gcd(q-1,2^{\ell}-1)\) nonzero solutions. Exponent one of the last weight guarantees a uniform nonzero root target; independence yields Bernoulli factors. Direct cycle-index sum yields exact all-moment and idempotent-free series. Divisibility and support semigroup are equivalences, not finite experiments. The fixed-field singularity transfer identifies every maximal Fourier exponent with precisely the r-th roots, yielding the stated asymptotic. Exhaustive finite-field tests independently match probabilities and moments in 21 cases, but infinity is proved symbolically.

originality.rationale: Earlier per-cycle formulas for individual idempotents and cycle direct-sum decomposition are known from Narkuziyev (2014); these are not claimed new. The 2026 random-evolution-algebra survey studies all invertible matrices and gives mean one rather than the monomial distribution with mean dimension. Source comparisons reveal no exact global cycle-index law for the uniformly weighted-permutation probability measure, complete moment series, sharp arithmetic dimension semigroup, or field-dependent polynomial asymptotics. Risk remains because a 2020 follow-up was not fully accessible and a finite-field specialization of old cycle-index methods might be implicit in unindexed literature. The PASS is a qualified same mathematical model literature comparison, not certified absolute priority.
residual_risks: The 2020 Narkuziyev follow-up was not accessible in full and may contain additional finite-field special cases.
